entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold for twenty minutes. I bought these VeloFit cycling shoes a while back and they are absolute trash. I want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Mike Schmidt, order 788-1B45. And don't give me some corporate runaround. These things are useless.

Thank you, Mr. Schmidt. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the Mountain Bike Shoes. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

The issue is they're horribly designed! I finally got a chance to take them on a real trail and they gave me painful blisters within an hour. The placement for the cleats feels totally off, I can't get any power. They're junk.
I understand your frustration. Getting blisters can definitely ruin a ride. So the main problem is the fit and comfort rather than a broken part, correct?

Don't play word games with me! They don't work! I want a full refund, and if you tell me no, you're going to put me through to a manager right now. I am not afraid to leave a one-star review on every website I can find.
I understand your position, sir, and there's no need for that. Please allow me just one moment to review our return policy for your order.
Fine. But you have sixty seconds before I start demanding supervisors.
Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've reviewed your account. I see the order was delivered 57 days ago. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window for these shoes.
(Voice loses its edge) Wait, what? Ninety days? Are you sure?
Yes, absolutely. I can go ahead and process this return for you right now. No problem at all.
(Tone shifts to surprise and relief) Oh. Well... okay then. That's... great. I was expecting a fight.

Not at all. I've just authorized the return. I'm sending an email to you now with a prepaid shipping label. Just package the cycling shoes back in a box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Huh. Okay. A prepaid label. That's easy enough. Thanks, David.
You're very welcome, Mr. Schmidt. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. You've handled it. Thank you.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
